items.raw_excerpt: Ao reunir artistas, realizadores, pesquisadores e público, o festival pretende promover narrativas capazes de gerar diálogo, memória e novas formas de se olhar para o mundo.
items.summary_en: A film festival in Sao Luis, Brazil is about to turn 50. It starts on the 20th. Artists, filmmakers, researchers and the public come together to share stories that create dialogue, memory and new ways of seeing the world.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 상루이스의 한 영화제가 곧 50주년을 맞습니다. 이 영화제는 20일에 시작됩니다. 예술가, 영화 제작자, 연구자, 관객이 함께 모여 대화와 기억, 세상을 보는 새로운 방식을 만들어 내는 이야기를 나눕니다.
items.title_en: Brazil film festival is almost 50 years old, starts on the 20th
items.title_original: Perto de completar 50 anos, Festival Guarnicê de Cinema começa dia 20

items.summary_en: Many people spend hours in the gym to get in shape for a summer holiday. After a few weeks of relaxing, we return to the gym with the same goal. This playlist helps you tone up and get back into your training routine.
